lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: COLLEGE YEAR 2! Sophomore ka na — wala nang 'freshie excuse'. Mas mabibigat na majors, mas mahal na lab/materials fees, at totoong test ng tiyaga sa {course}.
lines.textEn: COLLEGE YEAR 2! Sophomore status — no more freshie excuses. Heavier majors, steeper lab fees, and a real test of grit in {course}.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Warning daw ng mga 3rd year: dito sa 2nd year pinakamaraming nagshi-shift o nalalagas! Kaya natin 'to basta walang susuko!
lines.textEn: Upperclassmen warned us: 2nd year is the biggest weed-out year! We can survive if nobody gives up!

choices.text: Mag-set ng strict study + work routine para steady ang GWA!
choices.textEn: Lock in a strict study-and-work routine to keep GWA steady!

journal.title: Sophomore Year sa {course}
journal.summary: Nagsimula ang 2nd Year — simula na ng totoong major subjects.
journal.summaryEn: Entered 2nd Year — the core major subjects begin in earnest.

choices.text: Huminga muna at unahin ang mental health ngayong simula ng sem.
choices.textEn: Pace yourself and protect your mental health from day one.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Midterm crunch ng 2nd year. Nakatitig ka sa syllabus ng {course} habang iniisip: 'Para ba talaga sa akin 'to? O mas bagay ako sa ibang kurso na mas kaya ng budget at puso ko?'
lines.textEn: Sophomore midterm crunch. Staring at your {course} syllabus, a quiet doubt creeps in: 'Is this truly my path, or would another course fit my heart and budget better?'

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Kung nahihirapan ka, {name}, walang masama sa pag-shift ng kurso... pero kung mahal mo pa rin ang {course}, nandito kami para tumulong sa'yo.
lines.textEn: If you are struggling, {name}, there is zero shame in shifting courses... and if you still love {course}, we are right here to back you up.

choices.text: Ilalaban ko pa rin ang {course}! Hindi ako susuko!
choices.textEn: I am sticking with {course}! Not giving up now!

choices.text: Mag-shift sa BS Business Administration (BSBA) — mas bagay sa diskarte ko!
choices.textEn: Shift to BS Business Administration (BSBA) — fits my hustle better!

journal.title: Nag-shift sa BSBA
journal.summary: Nagdesisyon kang lumipat sa BSBA kahit maging irregular — mas buo ang loob mo ngayon.
journal.summaryEn: Made the brave leap to shift into BSBA — irregular schedule, lighter heart.

choices.text: Mag-shift sa BS Information Technology (BSIT) — mas malaki ang freelance potential!
choices.textEn: Shift to BS Information Technology (BSIT) — stronger freelance potential!

journal.title: Nag-shift sa BSIT
journal.summary: Lumipat ka sa BSIT para pagsabayin ang tech skills at freelance income.
journal.summaryEn: Shifted to BSIT to pair tech skills with freelance income.

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: {name}, sabay ang bayaran ng tuition mo at meralco share ngayong buwan. Nagtaas na naman ng singil ang kuryente dahil sa init!
lines.textEn: {name}, tuition and electricity share landed in the same week. Power bills jumped again because of the summer heat!

choices.text: Bayaran ang tuition + utilities mula sa ipon (-₱1,600).
choices.textEn: Settle tuition and utilities from your savings (-₱1,600).

choices.text: Mag-extra shift kay Aling Nena para bawas sa bayarin! (Play Carinderia Rush)
choices.textEn: Work an extra shift at Aling Nena's to offset the bill! (Play Carinderia Rush)

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: End of 1st Semester ng 2nd Year! Evaluation na ng scholarship renewal at Dean's List. Sana napanatili ninyo ang magandang GWA!
lines.textEn: End of 2nd Year 1st Semester! Scholarship renewal and Dean's List evaluations are out. Hope you protected your GWA!

choices.text: I-submit ang grade slip sa Scholarship Office.
choices.textEn: Submit your grade slip to the Scholarship Office.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Surprise oral recitation! Walang bubuklat ng notebook. Kapag hindi nakasagot, minus 10 sa midterm standing!
lines.textEn: Surprise graded recitation! Close your notebooks. Blank answers mean minus 10 on midterms!

choices.text: Huminga nang malalim at sumagot gamit ang stock knowledge at logic!
choices.textEn: Stay composed and reason through the question aloud!

choices.text: Maging tapat kung saan nalito at itanong ang tamang konsepto.
choices.textEn: Admit honestly where you got stuck and ask to clarify.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Anak, na-delay ang padala/kita natin ngayong buwan pero nakaipon ako ng ₱700 para pandagdag sa exam permit mo. Kaya mo ba ang natitira?
lines.textEn: Anak, money came in late this month, but I scraped together ₱700 toward your exam permit. Can you cover the remainder?

choices.text: Tanggapin ang tulong ni Mama at bayaran ang balance (-₱900 net).
choices.textEn: Accept Mama's help and pay the remaining balance (-₱900 net).

choices.text: 'Huwag na Ma, itago mo 'yan sa bahay! Kaya ko na 'to!' (-₱1,600).
choices.textEn: 'Keep it for home, Ma! I have this covered!' (-₱1,600).

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: HALFWAY THERE! Tapos na ang 2nd Year! Dalawang taon na lang — 3rd Year at Thesis/OJT na!
lines.textEn: HALFWAY THERE! 2nd Year is in the books! Two more years — Junior year and Thesis/OJT ahead!

choices.text: Mag-summer hustle para may pondo sa 3rd year (+₱650, -Energy).
choices.textEn: Hustle during summer break to build a 3rd-year buffer (+₱650).

journal.title: Kalahati na ng Kolehiyo!
journal.summary: Nalampasan mo ang nakakatakot na 2nd year. Papasok ka na sa 3rd year!
journal.summaryEn: Cleared the notorious sophomore weed-out year. Junior year awaits!

choices.text: Umuwi sa {hometown} para magpahinga kasama ang pamilya (++Energy, ++Mental).
choices.textEn: Go home to {hometown} for real rest with family (++Energy, ++Mental).

lines.speaker: Small Business Owner
lines.text: Ikaw ba si {name}? Ni-refer ka ni Aling Nena! Kailangan namin ng student na mag-aayos ng social media menu at weekend deliveries — ₱500 plus tip!
lines.textEn: Are you {name}? Aling Nena recommended you! We need a student to design our menu and help with weekend orders — ₱500 plus tips!

choices.text: I-refer si Miggy para maghati kayo sa komisyon (+₱200, +Miggy).
